description.en: August 21, 2026, FROMM FAMILY FOODS of MEQUON, Wisconsin  is recalling 3,852 cases of Fromm Turkey Pâté Wet canned dog food and 1,973 cases of Fromm Diner Classics Milo's Meatloaf Pâté Wet canned dog food due to potential metal contamination.
